updates.reachability_and_limits: The cursor universal-hash MAC comparison uses ctutils; PostgreSQL and digest paths also depend on it. The affected mask/32-bit operation was not shown exploitable in this task. Fixed upstream implementation selected; functional AEAD vectors are not constant-time proof.

Inspected application TLS uses the ring provider, no ECH or custom session store, and acquisition resumption is disabled. Selected feature graph has no Brotli or post-quantum provider. These limits reduce reachability of the reported cases but do not waive policy.

Actual acquisition and configured PostgreSQL certificate validation uses this verifier. Updated chain validation rejects the distrusted intermediate public keys, including paths allowed by configured roots.

Product source has no direct AsyncFd constructor usage. The patched release introduces unsafe registration and deprecates the unsound safe constructors; this task adds no unsafe application code. The cancellation component was exercised on the new runtime.
The product acquisition TLS policy uses this public root store. Removal of the affected emSign root changes real trust acceptance; PostgreSQL continues to use separately configured roots.

Unconditional libduckdb-sys build dependency. Maintained builds set explicit verified DUCKDB_LIB_DIR and bypass the upstream downloader/extractor. The dependency remains fixed in the audited graph. ZIP 9.0.5 preserves the used new/extract API and includes post-9.0.0 symlink corrections; its extractor does not claim protection against concurrent destination mutation.

Reported allocator failure is confined to wasm32, not the selected native targets. Source comparison confirms all 104 bundled Zstandard files unchanged. Patched wrapper retains Zstandard 1.5.7; no new engine qualification is inferred.
